name: Zoho Flow
description: Zoho Flow is an AI-powered integration platform that connects cloud and on-premises apps and automates workflows across departments.
best_for: Businesses already using Zoho's app ecosystem who want no-code workflow automation connecting 1,000+ cloud and on-premises apps.
features: Natural-language flow generation that builds workflows from plain-English descriptions
1,000+ supported cloud and on-premises app integrations
Custom functions using the Deluge scripting language
Multiple trigger sources including polling APIs, webhooks, templated emails, and RSS feeds
Agentic AI actions that choose a course of action based on real-time context
Workflow monitoring with the ability to restart or rerun specific parts of a flow

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 100 tasks/month, 5 flows, 30-day flow history, and base app connectors.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Flat org price, not per-seat. 5,000 tasks/month, unlimited flows, custom functions ($29/mo billed monthly).

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Flat org price, not per-seat. 10,000 tasks/month, premium apps, on-prem integration ($49/mo billed monthly).

alternatives.name: Zapier
alternatives.description: A no-code automation platform that connects thousands of web apps through simple trigger-and-action workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want fast, no-code automations between cloud apps

alternatives.name: Make
alternatives.description: A visual automation platform for building multi-step workflows between apps with a drag-and-drop scenario builder.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want visual, complex multi-step automations

alternatives.name: Pipedream
alternatives.description: A developer-focused integration and automation platform for building workflows that connect APIs, AI, and databases with code-level control when needed.
alternatives.best_for: Developers who want visual workflows with optional custom code
